description: This Java source file defines a final class 'CorrelationIdEnsuringDirective' that provides an Akka HTTP directive to ensure each HTTP request has a correlation ID, generating a new one if it does not exist.

classes.name: CorrelationIdEnsuringDirective
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to add or retrieve a correlation ID from HTTP requests in Akka HTTP routing.

methods.name: ensureCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns an Akka Route that extracts or generates a correlation ID and applies a provided function to produce the route.

methods.name: getCorrelationIdFromHeaders
methods.description: Helper method that attempts to retrieve the correlation ID from request headers, supporting multiple header names.

methods.name: createNewCorrelationId
methods.description: Helper method generating a new UUID-based correlation ID string.
